idea-plugin.name: Codex
idea-plugin.description: Launch the interactive Codex CLI in a dedicated JetBrains Terminal tab at the current project root, then stage project file and selection references from the editor popup. Codex owns authentication, model selection, permissions, configuration, and session state in the terminal.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.3.0: Add Send to Codex for staging editor file and line references in a running Codex CLI terminal.
  • 0.2.1: Use the official Codex product mark and correct the plugin author metadata.
  • 0.2.0: Replace the app-server chat tool window with a terminal-first Codex CLI launcher.

action.description: Open Codex in the built-in Terminal
Stage the current file or selection in the running Codex CLI
